stories.title: Seahawks' D forces three interceptions, escape injury riddled SB rematch with win over Pats
Barry Melrose, former coach and beloved ESPN hockey analyst, dies at 70
stories.summary: Barry Melrose, the former NHL player and coach who was a beloved, longtime hockey analyst for ESPN, died Wednesday, his wife, Cindy, told ESPN's Steve Levy.

stories.title: After rocky start to US Open, Zverev reaches 4th major semi of 2026
stories.summary: Alexander Zverev's rocky road to start the US Open turned into smooth sailing to the semifinals.

stories.title: LSU, SEC rift cools as Tigers say issue 'moot' after complying
stories.summary: In what appears to be a deescalation, LSU president Wade Rousse told Greg Sankey that the Tigers have "complied" with SEC rules and that the "issue is moot."

stories.title: Sources: Raiders' Bowers has knee procedure, out 'a game or two'
stories.summary: Raiders star tight end Brock Bowers underwent a meniscus trim Tuesday in Dallas and is expected to miss "a game or two," league sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.
